source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 940 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 940 was established by Ordinance No. 29709, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 22, 2015. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 940 is established on property generally bounded by Bennett Avenue, Capitol Avenue, and Fitzhugh Avenue. The size of PD 940 is approximately 1.827 acres. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 940A: development plan.

(2) Exhibit 940B: landscape plan. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 940A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The following uses are the only main uses permitted:

-- General merchandise or food store greater than 3,500 square feet.

-- Local utilities. [SUP or RAR may be required. See Section 51A-4.212(4).] (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the CR Community Retail District apply.

(b) Height. Maximum structure height is 36 feet. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 940B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.112. SCREENING.

To screen residential adjacency, a minimum eight-foot-high solid screening fence must be provided along the southeast Property line as shown on the development plan. The solid screening fence must be constructed of wood panels with brick columns or entirely of brick. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.113. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) Detached signs are limited to two monument signs. One monument sign may be no more than ten feet in height and must be located along Fitzhugh Avenue or at the corner of Fitzhugh Avenue and Capitol Avenue. The other monument sign may be no more than six feet in height and must be located along Bennett Avenue or at the corner of Bennett Avenue and Capitol Avenue. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Maximum height for parking lot lighting poles is 18 feet.

(b) Excluding fenestration, building facades must be constructed of masonry materials. For purposes of this provision, cement board siding, stucco, and Exterior Insulation Finish System (EFIS) are considered masonry materials.

(c) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(d) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29709)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-940.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29709)
